field_edits.updated_text: No acute fracture, avascular necrosis, or aggressive osseous lesion. Normal marrow signal is demonstrated. Prior marrow edema/bone contusions involving the acetabular walls, femoral head, femoral neck, and greater trochanter have near‑complete resolution with no residual STIR hyperintensity.
There is a minimal residual hip joint effusion, markedly decreased compared to the prior study. No trochanteric bursitis.
